name_cn: 吴江恩浩纺织品有限公司
main_products: Polyester taffeta, oxford, satin, nida (abaya fabric), lam lam, bengaline, memory fabric
woven_evidence: Its products (taffeta, oxford, satin, nida and bengaline) are woven polyester fabrics.

canton_fair.evidence_note: Named in the China Textile News report on the Shengze delegation at the 139th Canton Fair.

notes: Nida is an abaya fabric, which is relevant for KSA. Directories give conflicting founding years and addresses, and one says it belongs to Wujiang Weichang Textile. Layer 2 should confirm it owns looms.
